levers.reason: Full variant needs the Q-RoPE inside the FlashInfer SM120 sparse-MLA prologue, which round 2 must not modify (XSPLIT, round 3). The exact-by-construction sub-variant (fused insert on an aux stream on the 8 indexer layers) is already covered by round-1 r1-attn IDXPAR (G20), which moves exactly that main wq_b -> SWA-insert chain to its own stream; a second edit of the same region would conflict.

flags.name: DSV41_ATTNOUT_OP
flags.meaning: Comma list of parts: rope = fold inverse RoPE into the sonar wo_a partial A load; rq = split reduce + MXFP8 quant fused (wo_b gets QuantizedActivation); st1 = partial num_stages 1; vs = vectorised [4,BN] E8M0 scale load; bn128 = 16x128 partial tile. Aliases 1|on|all = rope,rq; tune = st1,vs. Unset/''/0/off = module never imported, live path unchanged. Any OTHER unknown value (e.g. 'false', 'no') is treated as on by o_proj.py and the lazily imported module raises ValueError at the first o_proj call -> the worker crashes loudly at boot (never a silent wrong setting). Each part self-checks bitwise against the live kernels on the first 16 eager calls (real + synthetic hostile data); a difference OR an exception in a check disables the part (ERROR '[r2-attnout] ... DISABLED' in rank0.log) and the live kernels run. A part never runs unchecked: in capture and after the check budget, unchecked parts use the live kernels.
